tasks.title: Implement FastMCP server with 10 agency tools
tasks.description: Expose Aethon agency operations over MCP for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, and VS Code.
tasks.details: Add backend/mcp_server.py, support stdio and HTTP transports, validate org access in every tool, and document setup for external MCP clients.
tasks.testStrategy: Start the MCP server in stdio and HTTP modes, verify tool registration, and exercise representative tool calls against real database data.

tasks.title: Add Gmail OAuth endpoints and encrypted token storage
tasks.description: Support one-click Gmail connection from the integrations page with CSRF protection and token refresh.
tasks.details: Add OAuth start, callback, and refresh endpoints, exchange Google codes for tokens, store refresh/access tokens in UserIntegration, and expose connection state to the frontend.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate the Gmail OAuth endpoints with backend tests, ensure token refresh updates stored credentials, and confirm the integrations UI builds cleanly.

tasks.title: Add Slack OAuth flow and integrations UI connected state
tasks.description: Mirror the Gmail connection experience for Slack and show connected account metadata in the integrations UI.
tasks.details: Implement Slack OAuth start/callback flow, store workspace tokens securely, and update the integrations page to handle connect, connected, test, and disconnect states.
tasks.testStrategy: Use backend OAuth tests plus frontend build verification to confirm the Slack cards and callback flow render correctly.

tasks.title: Ship scheduled automation, cron validation, and signed webhooks
tasks.description: Let agencies enable recurring workflows and external webhook triggers with safe validation and org scoping.
tasks.details: Add scheduled workflow APIs, three quick automation templates, signed public webhook URLs, webhook trigger execution, and schedule management in the Workflows page.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify invalid cron strings return 422, confirm one-minute schedules create executions in the live stack, and ensure signed webhook triggers enqueue runs successfully.

tasks.title: Add notification preferences and daily digest plumbing
tasks.description: Give agencies control over approval, execution, autonomy, and digest notifications with SMTP-ready delivery hooks.
tasks.details: Create notification preference storage, notification settings API and page, approval/autonomy email hooks, and daily digest scheduling support.
tasks.testStrategy: Run backend tests for notification preferences, confirm API responses are live, and verify frontend routes/build include the new settings page.

tasks.title: Finish developer experience onboarding for Phase 16 contributors
tasks.description: Give contributors an instant, tool-friendly starting point with repo rules, structured tasks, and spec-driven workflows.
tasks.details: Add the repo constitution files, Cursor rules, contributor README guidance, Task Master scaffolding, and spec-kit structure so AI coding tools open with the right project context.
tasks.testStrategy: Confirm CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, .taskmaster, and .specify exist, then verify task-master list and task-master next return actionable Phase 16 contributor context.
